description: Manages an Exchange Online mailbox (New-Mailbox / Get-Mailbox / Set-Mailbox / Remove-Mailbox). Best suited to shared, room and equipment mailboxes; user mailboxes are normally provisioned by licensing a user in Entra ID.

name.description: The mailbox name (New-Mailbox -Name). Changing it renames the mailbox in place via Set-Mailbox -Name; it does not recreate it, because the resource is keyed on the mailbox GUID.

type.description: Mailbox type. shared/room/equipment map to the New-Mailbox -Shared/-Room/-Equipment switches. 'user' additionally requires user_principal_name and password, and is rarely the right choice in Exchange Online - license a user in Entra ID instead. Changing this converts the mailbox in place via Set-Mailbox -Type.

user_principal_name.description: UPN for a type = "user" mailbox (New-Mailbox -MicrosoftOnlineServicesID). Create-only: the UPN of an existing mailbox is owned by Entra ID, so update.ps1 refuses a change rather than silently ignoring it.

password.description: Initial password for a type = "user" mailbox (New-Mailbox -Password). Used only at creation and never read back or reconciled; changing it has no effect.

alias.description: Mail alias (the part of the address before @). Exchange derives one when this is unset; read it back from effective_alias.

display_name.description: Display name shown in address lists. Defaults to name when unset; read it back from effective_display_name.

primary_smtp_address.description: The mailbox's primary SMTP address, applied after creation via Set-Mailbox -WindowsEmailAddress. Leave unset to let Exchange derive it from the alias and the tenant's accepted domains, then read it back from effective_primary_smtp_address.

email_addresses.description: The complete proxy-address list (Set-Mailbox -EmailAddresses), e.g. ["SMTP:sales@contoso.com", "smtp:sales@contoso.onmicrosoft.com"]. Uppercase SMTP: marks the primary address. This is authoritative: setting it replaces every existing address, so include the ones Exchange added itself. Leave it unset to manage addresses outside Terraform.

hidden_from_address_lists.description: Hide the mailbox from address lists (Set-Mailbox -HiddenFromAddressListsEnabled).

custom_attributes.description: Exchange custom attributes, keyed "1" through "15": { "1" = "finance" } sets Set-Mailbox -CustomAttribute1. Any other key is an error.

litigation_hold_enabled.description: Place the mailbox on litigation hold (Set-Mailbox -LitigationHoldEnabled). Requires the appropriate licence in the tenant.

litigation_hold_duration_days.description: How long litigation hold retains items, in days (Set-Mailbox -LitigationHoldDuration).

retention_policy.description: Name of the retention policy to apply (Set-Mailbox -RetentionPolicy). The policy must already exist in the tenant.

issue_warning_quota.description: Quota at which the user is warned, as an Exchange size string, e.g. "49 GB" (Set-Mailbox -IssueWarningQuota).

prohibit_send_quota.description: Quota at which the mailbox can no longer send, e.g. "49.5 GB" (Set-Mailbox -ProhibitSendQuota).

prohibit_send_receive_quota.description: Quota at which the mailbox can no longer send or receive, e.g. "50 GB" (Set-Mailbox -ProhibitSendReceiveQuota).

max_send_size.description: Largest message the mailbox may send, e.g. "35 MB" (Set-Mailbox -MaxSendSize).

max_receive_size.description: Largest message the mailbox may receive, e.g. "36 MB" (Set-Mailbox -MaxReceiveSize).

grant_send_on_behalf_to.description: Recipients allowed to send on behalf of this mailbox (Set-Mailbox -GrantSendOnBehalfTo). Authoritative: the list replaces whatever is configured.

forwarding_smtp_address.description: External address to forward mail to (Set-Mailbox -ForwardingSmtpAddress). Pair with deliver_to_mailbox_and_forward to keep a copy.

deliver_to_mailbox_and_forward.description: Keep a copy in the mailbox as well as forwarding (Set-Mailbox -DeliverToMailboxAndForward).

resource_capacity.description: Seating capacity of a room or equipment mailbox (Set-Mailbox -ResourceCapacity).

permanently_delete.description: On destroy, pass Remove-Mailbox -PermanentlyDelete so the mailbox is not recoverable. Without it Exchange soft-deletes the mailbox and retains it for 30 days, which can collide with recreating a mailbox of the same name.

additional_parameters.description: Escape hatch: a JSON object of extra Set-Mailbox parameters, splatted onto the cmdlet after every attribute above, e.g. jsonencode({ Office = "HQ", RequireSenderAuthenticationEnabled = false }). Keys are Set-Mailbox parameter names and win over anything this resource sets. Terraform cannot validate them, and values here are not reflected in any computed attribute.

external_directory_object_id.description: The mailbox's Entra ID object ID.

effective_primary_smtp_address.description: The primary SMTP address Exchange actually resolved, whether or not primary_smtp_address was set.

effective_display_name.description: The display name Exchange actually resolved.

effective_user_principal_name.description: The mailbox's current UPN as reported by Get-Mailbox.

effective_email_addresses.description: Every proxy address on the mailbox, including the SIP: and SPO: entries Exchange adds itself. Use this when building an authoritative email_addresses list.

recipient_type_details.description: Exchange's own classification: SharedMailbox, UserMailbox, RoomMailbox or EquipmentMailbox.

distinguished_name.description: The mailbox's distinguished name in the Exchange directory.

is_directory_synced.description: Whether the underlying object is synchronised from on-premises Active Directory. Synced objects cannot be fully managed from Exchange Online.
